newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Bank closes US$150 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: First Bank closes US$150 mln FRCD.

text.p: First Commercial Bank's US$150 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue has been allocated, arranger Citicorp International said on Thursday.
The facility has a final maturity of five years with a call option in year three.
The issue was priced at par to float at 20 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 23 basis points.
Arrangers are Citicorp International, Tokyo-Mitsuibishi and WestLB.
Co-arrangers are ANZ, First Chicago and Sumitomo Finance Asia.
Senior lead managers are Merrill Lynch and Daiwa Securities.
Lead managers are Asahi Finance, Landesbank Hessen-Thuringen and NordLB.
Managers are Banca Nazionale Del Lavoro, National Bank of Abu Dhabi, Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino, Toyo Trust and Yokohama.
